invariants.rationale: Returned list of WriteStatus should not be null after delete operation.
instantTime parameter is used with Option.ofNullable and preWrite, so is likely required to be non-null.
keys parameter must be non-null to perform delete operations.
Number of WriteStatus results should not exceed the number of HoodieKeys requested for deletion.
Result is a List, so its size is always non-negative (>=0).
